title: Eventual exactness and finite locally free kernels of an affine lift
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a quasi-compact open, F a perfect object of D(O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex], and K a bounded-above complex of finite free O_X-modules whose derived restriction represents F. Write R for restriction of module sheaves to U. There is an integer N such that, for every r at most N, R(K) is exact in every degree at most r and the kernel of R(d^r) is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. This only concerns the restricted complex; no equality of image and kernel on X is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08EG, proof of Lemma 36.13.6, finite-free lift and stupid truncation; read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EG

proof.text: Install derived localizations on open subschemes of U by transporting the already supplied over-site localizations through Modules.overEquiv. Compactness of the subtype U gives CompactSpace U.toScheme. Apply perfect_isPseudoCoherent_and_hasLocallyFiniteTorDimension, then hasFiniteTorDimension_of_locallyFinite, to obtain a common interval [a,b]. Exact-functor mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the supplied representing isomorphism identify Q(L) with F, where L is the actual termwise restricted complex.

Test tensor vanishing against the unit. Unpack its K-flat witness P; mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso followed by the right unitor identifies its tensor with P itself. DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors transports zero homology along Q(L) ≅ F ≅ Q(P), proving L.ExactAt i for i<a. Restriction preserves finite freeness by overFunctorEquiv, restrictFunctorIsoPullback and pullbackFreeIso. Finite free sheaves are flat by flat_coproduct and transport along their isomorphisms, so L is K-flat by the bounded-above-flat criterion.

For each G, unpack its tensor vanishing witness P. Apply kFlat_derivedTensor_comparison_natIso to constant singleton families for both L and P. Tensor the representing isomorphism Q(L) ≅ Q(P) with Q(G[0]) and compose the comparisons. homologyFunctorFactors and mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso give ExactAt i for the ordinary termwise tensor L tensor G when i<a. For r<a apply the proved upstream CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt (WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.FlatModel) at r-1; the required tensor-exact degree is r-2<a. Conjugate the two defining finite-free terms by their free isomorphisms, use opcyclesIsCokernel, and construct presentationOfIsCokernelFree. Its finite generating and relation index sets prove finite presentation of the opcycles.

FlatSheafStalk gives flat stalks of the opcycles. Apply relative_flat_of_stalks to the identity morphism, using restrictScalarsId'App to identify identity restriction of stalk scalars. Specialize its affine-section criterion to the same affine open on both sides and identify the identity appLE ring homomorphism. Finite presentation of affine sections and isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isAffineOpen give finite local freeness.

Exactness at r-1 and r makes L.opcyclesToCycles (r-1) r monic and epic, using the short-complex mono_fromOpcycles and epi_toCycles criteria and the two canonical factorization identities. In the abelian category it is an isomorphism. Compose with cyclesIsoSc' and cyclesIsoKernel, then transport IsFiniteLocallyFree. Set N=a-1; i≤r≤N implies i<a. The compactness theorem inserts zero endpoints for empty covers, and every subsequent argument also includes empty opens, zero sheaves, and rank-zero free terms.

theorem affine_lift_eventual_free_kernels
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (hF : IsPerfect U.toScheme F)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hrep : Nonempty
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ F)) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ r : ℤ, r ≤ N →
      (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ r → ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).ExactAt i) ∧
      (kernel (R.map (K.d r (r + 1)))).IsFiniteLocallyFree
